_source: REP_AUDIT_FIXTURE (representative-audit-slice.json) for everything the AUDIT side needs (ground-truth plateau, labelled tracks_raw, each dump's radius_tracks) + each dump's LIVE tracks.json (production band reconstruction only, which the reduced radius_tracks cannot supply) for the 2026-08-04 hybrid-landing audit (docs/probe-runs.md §13). Constraint 9 self-validation, same precedent as the other pellets/*-audit-slice.json fixtures.
_note: `labelled` carries production's per-frame `band` series for both crops (structural/template) over the SAME window REP_AUDIT_FIXTURE's labelled block covers. `dumps` carries production's `band` series for each of the 5 full-clip dumps, full length, local-indexed 0..n-1 (offset 0 -- these are un-sliced). Regenerate with analyze-pellet-tracks.py --hybrid-landing-audit <dump-dir...> --save-hybrid-landing-audit-fixture <path> [--hybrid-landing-audit-ts-lockstep] (the TS lockstep needs `npx tsx` and is NOT replayed by the selftest, same live-only convention as audit_representative's FULL-CLIP CONTROL).
